_note: INERT — this file holds no secret and is never read for credentials. The owner activation token hash used to live here as an unsalted SHA-256 value; it was removed in the Step 5 security fix (S5-04) and must be treated as compromised. The hash now lives ONLY in the server env var AENURAL_OWNER_ACTIVATION_TOKEN_HASH (scrypt format, generated by scripts/membership/generate-owner-token.mjs) and the owner email ONLY in AENURAL_OWNER_EMAIL. The email field below is a placeholder that the code ignores — never activate against it. See docs/authentication/owner-activation-rotation.md.
